title: Gojo's Hollow Purple Is Actually Real Math
description:
Satoru Gojo's most iconic technique wasn't invented from nothing. The author drew from Zeno's paradox, convergent infinite series, and imaginary numbers to build the Limitless power system. Here's the actual math behind it.
